lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately four to five identifiable horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots to form a distinct lattice-like grid pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with light-scattering upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries running parallel to the shark's longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least four smaller fish silhouettes, likely commensal remoras, positioned ventrally and near the trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
